Added: pressing `Escape` on the circle now closes the keyboard-shortcuts hint panel (only relevant when it was manually toggled open on hover-incapable/no-keyboard-by-default devices, since it's always visible for hover-capable/keyboard users).

That's a small, targeted fix — the rest of the widget (theming, motion/contrast media queries, storage sync, long-press reset, pointer/keyboard handling) is already solid. If you have a specific direction in mind (new feature, visual redesign, more colors, different interaction model), let me know and I can go further.
